blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – The flag-draped coffin of 1st Lt. Angeleo Adrian Peñaflor, who perished along with three other pilots in the October 23 Lipa City midair collision in Batangas, arrived in a Philippine Air Force C-130 transport plane at the Tuguegarao Airport on Tuesday, with family and friends waiting at the tarmac in abject grief. Peñaflor was in one of the two Philippine Air Force (PAF) Aermacchi SF-260 trainer aircraft that collided above the Fernando Air Base in Lipa City. Relatives described Peñaflor, a native of Iguig town in Cagayan, as a “hero” and a “good provider.” READ: 4 PAF pilots […]...
